svg.title: Fry readability graph with recipe book (curved text lines, printed style)
svg.desc: Graph with autumn suns/beams and an open recipe book. Pages curve into the spine. Text lines follow the page curves with spaces, simulating printed words. Brown leather cover with gilded corners is intact, cookies on a plate on the left page.
